genericity_policy: A rational degree-six class Hodge at the specified algebraically independent period point satisfies the cleared rational Lie-J equations identically, hence at all 19 samples. The modular minor gives a rational rank lower bound; the three universal rational Hodge classes give the matching upper bound. Never infer generic Hodge dimension from one special fiber.

projectors.Chow_license: Rational combinations of algebraic automorphism pullbacks tau^k on CH^3(X)_Q. Finite order tau^4=Id gives a genuine Chow idempotent, not a rank-two full-cohomology projector.

positive_witness_criterion: An actual algebraic beta with cl(beta)-tau*cl(beta) nonzero gives a nonzero rational Weil class and hence an explicit algebraic representative of alpha. Merely nonzero in Chow is insufficient.
negative_criterion: All-cycle annihilation of O is equivalent to every codimension-three algebraic cycle class being tau-invariant on this fixed X. This invariance is not proved.
next_action: Construct a cycle or algebraic bundle whose middle Chern/cycle class is not tau-invariant; audit higher-Chern/sheaf constructions rather than repeat the excluded divisorial-power library.
trust_scope: Exact finite-field minor certificate for a rational matrix, three rational universal Hodge generators and written algebraic-independence descent; standard torus Hodge and algebraic cycle functoriality facts imported. Genuine finite-order Chow idempotence is proved in the rational cyclic group algebra. Not proof-assistant certification, algebraicity of the Weil plane or global Hodge.
